title: Book of the Watchers dated to around 300 BC

tellings.quote: The oldest section, namely the book of the Watchers containing this the the Enochian tale of the Watchers that was written at least cir circa 300 BC.

plain: The Book of the Watchers, the oldest section of the ancient Jewish text known as 1 Enoch, was written at least around 300 BC, according to the researcher Tim Alberino. He gives the date himself, without naming a source, to show how old the tale of the Watchers it contains really is, which matters to him because it means the story of beings called the Watchers is very ancient.
